draft.emotion: respectful and slightly serious, recognizing someone with professional expertise
notes: Used for a male doctor or as the general word for a doctor of any gender ('idę do lekarza' — I'm going to the doctor). A female doctor is also called 'lekarka'.
When addressing a doctor directly, Poles say 'panie doktorze' (to a man) or 'pani doktor' (to a woman).
